msg.content: Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?
Where are the headquarters of the Big Five companies in the technology industry located?

content.content: We need headquarters of the Big Five tech companies: Amazon, Apple, Alphabet (Google), Meta (Facebook), Microsoft. Provide location. Provide city, state/region, country. Maybe mention main HQ. Probably the answer: Amazon - Seattle, Washington, USA; Apple - Cupertino, California, USA; Alphabet (Google) - Mountain View, California, USA; Meta - Menlo Park, California, USA; Microsoft - Redmond, Washington, USA. Provide brief description.

content:
**Headquarters of the “Big Five” U.S. technology companies (Amazon, Apple, Alphabet/Google, Meta, Microsoft)**  

| Company | Headquarters | City / State / Country |
|---------|--------------|------------------------|
| **Amazon** | Amazon Corporate Headquarters | Seattle, Washington, United States |
| **Apple** | Apple Park (Apple Corporate Headquarters) | Cupertino, California, United States |
| **Alphabet (Google)** | Alphabet Inc. (Google) Global Headquarters | Mountain View, California, United States |
| **Meta Platforms** | Meta Platforms (Facebook) Headquarters | Menlo Park, California, United States |
| **Microsoft** | Microsoft Corporate Headquarters | Redmond, Washington, United States |

> **Quick Notes**  
> - All five are headquartered in the United States.  
> - Washington state houses Amazon and Microsoft, while California hosts Apple, Alphabet (Google), and Meta.  
> - These cities are part of the broader tech hubs in the Pacific Northwest (Seattle/Redmond) and the San Francisco Bay Area (Cupertino, Mountain View, Menlo Park).
